about: Layout for build-chart.js. Lengths in S1 units unless named Px. S1's own proportions are kept: x-height 12 S1 units, strokes 1.0 wide, slant 22.5 degrees. slantDeg 22.5 means the chart keeps S1's slant unchanged; any other value shears the forms to that slant. narrow is the small-screen variant: the same block at a narrower page width, so it wraps into more rows.
